rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for throwing something.

example.english: When I got angry, I cast the pillow onto the floor.
example.traditional: 我一嬲就掟咗個枕頭落地下。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 nau1 zau6 deng3 zo2 go3 zam2 tau4 lok6 dei6 haa6

rows.note: Use this colloquial entertainment term for the group of actors in a production.

example.english: The cast of this movie is excellent.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 go3 kaa1 si2 hou2 ging6

rows.note: Use this in a medical context for the plaster cast supporting a broken bone.

example.english: The doctor said I need a cast.
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jiu3 daa2 sek6 gou1

rows.note: Use this specifically for making a metal object by pouring molten material into a mould.

example.english: This statue was cast in bronze.
example.traditional: 呢尊銅像係用青銅鑄成嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 zyun1 tung4 zoeng6 hai6 jung6 cing1 tung4 zyu3 sing4 ge3

rows.note: Use this when throwing something down, away, or aside, especially when discarding it.

example.english: We can cast these old newspapers aside now.
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 gau6 bou3 zi2 ho2 ji5 dam2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for assigning an actor to play a particular role in a performance.

example.english: The director will cast Ming as the lead.
example.jyutping: dou6 jin2 on1 paai4 aa3 ming4 zou6 zyu2 gok3

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase for one throwing action.

example.english: They cast the paper ball into the bin with one throw.
example.traditional: 佢一掟就將個紙團掟入垃圾桶。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 deng3 zau6 zoeng1 go3 zi2 tyun4 deng3 jap6 laap6 saap3 tung2

rows.note: Use this all-purpose noun for a mould used to make an object.

example.english: This plastic figurine was cast using this mould.
example.traditional: 呢件膠公仔係用呢個模具整出嚟㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 gaau1 gung1 zai2 hai6 jung6 ni1 go3 mou4 geoi6 zing2 ceot1 lai4 gaa3
